basic_details.job_title: TISS Graphic Designer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Office for International Affairs (OIA) of the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), Mumbai, has invited applications for one Graphic Designer post as a temporary, contractual non-teaching position. The appointment is for six months initially, with a consolidated remuneration of ₹25,000 to ₹30,000 per month. The qualification is a Bachelor's degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field. Applications are online through the "Apply Now" link on www.tiss.ac.in, and the last date to receive applications is 30 November 2026.

important_dates.joining: Selected candidates are expected to join within 15 days of their selection

how_to_apply: Apply online through the "Apply Now" link provided with the advertisement on the Institute's website, www.tiss.ac.in.
Complete the online application form and upload all required documents.

Pay the application fee online: Rs 500/- for General and OBC candidates. SC/ST/PWD candidates pay Rs. 125/- if they attach the required certificate with the application form. Women applicants are waived from the fee.
After successful submission, download and retain a printout of the acknowledgement/confirmation of the online application.

The application is valid only on receipt of the application fee, if applicable. Fees once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. The notice does not list the individual documents to upload.
important_instructions: The Institute reserves the right not to fill the vacancy advertised. No queries or correspondence regarding the issue of call letters for interview/selection will be entertained at any stage. Canvassing will lead to the candidate being debarred from consideration for the post. The selected candidate will have to join within a reasonable time from the date of their selection.

content_sections.heading: About TISS
content_sections.text: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences is a Deemed University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956, and a Grant-in-Aid Institute under the Ministry of Education, GoI, located at V.N. Purav Marg, Deonar, Mumbai 400 088. Its Office for International Affairs promotes international academic exchange and collaboration between TISS and foreign higher education institutions. The Graphic Designer will support the office's communication, branding and outreach work.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one essential qualification and a set of preferences for the single Graphic Designer position. The notice lists the following under "Preference": Experience of 1 year in professional design in an academic, non-profit, or international organisation is preferred. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Canva; working knowledge of basic video editing tools is an advantage. A strong portfolio demonstrating range across print and digital design. Good understanding of typography, layout, colour, and brand consistency. Relaxation in qualification, experience and age is the prerogative of TISS. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: This is a temporary appointment on a contract basis for six months initially. It may be extended based on the candidate's performance and the Institute's requirements. The consolidated remuneration is ₹25,000 to ₹30,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience. If the contract is extended, the appointed candidates will be paid an annual increment of 5% of their remuneration.

content_sections.heading: TISS Graphic Designer Job Description
content_sections.text: Design print and digital collateral for the International Office, including brochures, flyers, newsletters, posters, banners, and certificates. Create visual content for social media, the TISS website, and international partnership communications. Develop presentation decks, infographics, and reports for international conferences, MOUs, and events. Maintain and apply TISS's visual identity and branding guidelines consistently across all materials. Collaborate with the International Office team to conceptualise creative campaigns for student exchange, global partnerships, and international events. Support photo and video documentation of international events and edit visual content as required. Manage design timelines to ensure timely delivery of materials for programmes and events.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Graphic Designer
content_sections.text: The application is valid only on receipt of the application fee, if applicable. Fees once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. The notice does not list the individual documents to upload.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received may be shortlisted, so having the prescribed qualifications and experience does not entitle a person to be called for an interview. Eligible candidates will be informed by email to attend the online/in-person interview. The notice does not give an interview date. No TA/DA is payable for appearing in the written test and/or interview.
